versions.changelog: v2.0.0: Major upgrade integrating 6 advanced TCM approaches - 法证对应 (pattern-principle decomposition), 理法方药 (systematic formula learning), 君臣佐使 (monarch-minister analysis), 配伍结构 (compatibility structure), 方歌 (formula songs), 九种体质 (9 constitution types), 药物对比 (herb comparison matrix), 名医医案 (famous physician cases), and 一病多方择优推荐 (multi-formula recommendation). New references: formula-analysis.md and constitution-clinical.md.

Initial release: TCM prescription assistant based on Shanghan Lun, Jingui Yaolue, and Formula Study. Includes syndrome differentiation, formula database (150+ formulas), herb reference (450+ herbs), safety rules, and diagnosis guide.
